messages:
Priya (CSM): Morning team — quick weekly pulse for Atlas Health. Noticing QoW token burn down ~18% but monthly spend flat; want to confirm if this is lower traffic or more efficient prompts. Key quick numbers: tokens/day Mon 1.2M -> Sun 980k (≈18% WoW). p95 latency 420ms -> 520ms. Error rate 0.8% -> 1.6% (spike Tue 03:20 UTC to 3.4%). Could be model fallback on Tue. @Jordan can you check routing & fallback logs? @Alex please confirm if onboarding batch jobs were paused. Thanks.

Jordan (Solutions Eng): On it. Quick note — we deployed canary v2.1 Tue 03:18 UTC which included a different memory config. Early traces show fallback to the smaller context variant at ~03:26 for ~12 minutes. Pulling routing traces now.

Alex (CS): Onboarding batch was intentionally paused Wed 06:00–07:30 for tenant ingest. That should lower tokens, not raise latency. I'll check customer-side timing to ensure nothing else ran unexpectedly.

Riley (Ops): Infra saw increased queue latency Tue 03:20–03:40 correlating with autoscaler cooldown. It didn't scale quickly enough for two back-to-back spikes. Raising autoscaler threshold as follow-up.

RedwoodBot: Autoscaler override applied to pool "atlas-prod" by Riley at 08:12 UTC. Note: temporary override expires in 24h. :white_check_mark:

Jordan (Solutions Eng): Found the chain: OOM on node gpu-12 triggered model agent restart -> fallback routing to hosted-small model variant with higher per-token cost and longer latency. Spend per token up ~12% during fallback window; added ~2% to daily spend for that day.

Priya (CSM): Action items: 1) Ops (Riley) tune autoscaler to avoid cooldown gap for Atlas pool; 2) Eng (Jordan) investigate OOM root cause on gpu-12 and whether canary memory config introduced regression; 3) CS (Alex) confirm customer did not change prompt/template patterns or run extra integrations. Also note renewal watch: customer renewal in ~6 wks — we should include cost spike and mitigation in renewal brief to avoid surprise.

Alex (CS): I'll schedule a 30-min enablement session next Tue to review prompt efficiency and quick wins (templating, stop token tuning). Also customer asked about embeddings for search — could reduce token burn if adopted.

Riley (Ops): Autoscaler threshold adjusted and cooldown lowered for atlas-prod. Added short-term headroom. Monitoring dashboards updated; will report 24h signal.

Jordan (Solutions Eng): Created ENG-3421 with logs, heap dumps, and repro steps; assigned to runtime team, ETA EOD Friday.

Priya (CSM): Thanks all. I'll update Atlas with the mitigation steps and the plan for the enablement session. Marking this thread for weekly notes. If no follow-ups, I'll close by EOD tomorrow.

Alex (CS): Noted. I'll confirm session invite and include a quick cost-savings playbook.

Riley (Ops): Watching metrics now — queue latency returning to baseline.

Priya (CSM): Closing for now. Will reopen if any regression. :pray:
